mg.title: S4S teal wipe
mg.use: Only after the hook text goes out. Cut to 030_3174 at the middle of the wipe. Use it once.

mg.title: Out of my comfort zone

text.main: it has helped me get out of my comfort zone.

mg.use: Full-frame cutaway on “comfort zone”, then back to her face. It can hide the 108% punch-in cut.

mg.title: More outgoing
mg.src: Jasmine, 030_3174.MXF [00:27] “But now I'm like more outgoing. I can talk to people.”
mg.use: Top band. Each line lands on her word. Keep captions on.

mg.title: 12th grade tag
mg.use: Small tag on “12th grade”. Upper area, away from the captions.

mg.title: Head high

text.main: I can walk with my head high.

mg.use: Top band over Jasmine as she says it. Black text on the teal bar. End this part on her face.

mg.title: Focus on the shoes
mg.use: Frames the shoes when she opens the box. Move it to where the shoes sit.

mg.title: Cool enough

text.main: I think I'm going to look cool enough.

mg.use: Top band, back on her face for the end of the line. Keep captions on.

mg.title: So happy

text.main: I'm so happy that I got these shoes.

mg.use: Top band over her face on the last line. Out by the end of the 0.7 s hold.

note: The plan for this cut leaves room for only 9 graphics.
